package @PACKAGE@

@IMPORT@

/** Generated from examples/src/parity/CounterBody.scala.txt by
  * project/FacadeParity.scala: the same Counter text for every ecosystem
  * (SPEC 6.5). Do not edit the generated copy.
  */
object CounterBody extends App[Int]:
    val keys: Keymap[Int] = Keymap(
      bind('+', "increment")(_ + 1),
      bind('-', "decrement")(_ - 1),
      bind('q', "quit")(_ => Quit),
    )

    def init: Int = 0

    def update(n: Int, event: Event): Next[Int] = event match
        case Key.Char('0') => 0
        case Resize(_, _)  => n
        case other         => keys(n, other)

    def view(n: Int): View =
      column(
        text("Count: ", n.toString.bold.yellow).centered.size(1),
        help(keys).centered.size(1),
      ).flex(Flex.Center).bordered(" Counter ")
end CounterBody
